title: Peer/deliver: unknown chatId UNIQUE conflict returns serverFail, peer retries forever
description: Trigger: peer sends Peer/deliver with chatId X (unknown). Handler creates new direct chat. Peer then sends a second message with chatId Y (also unknown, different). UNIQUE INDEX chats_direct_contact(contact_id) WHERE kind='direct' fires on the second create, which maps to server_fail('internal error'). Peer's outbox retries forever since it receives a 500-equivalent with no actionable signal. Fix: before attempting chats().create, check if a direct chat already exists for this contact_id and adopt it (return idempotent success or return the existing chatId) rather than relying on the constraint violation as a signaling mechanism.
